**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.animation.tween.equation` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BounceTweenEquation.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/animation/tween/equation/BounceTweenEquation.java)

Easing curves that bounce, like a ball that falls and rebounds.

![The Bounce easing curves in a dark grey frame that marks 0 and 1: IN in blue, OUT in light grey, IN_OUT in grey, named under the curves, with one dot per curve that runs along it from the start to the end](/captures/catalog-easing-bouncetweenequation.webp)

## Description

Each constant is also in [`TweenEquations`](/reference/animation/tweenequations/), as `BOUNCE_IN`, `BOUNCE_OUT` and `BOUNCE_IN_OUT`.

## Constant and field details

<a id="BounceTweenEquation-constant-IN"></a>

### IN

`BounceTweenEquation IN` 

Bounces at the start.

<a id="BounceTweenEquation-constant-OUT"></a>

### OUT

`BounceTweenEquation OUT` 

Bounces at the end, like a ball that falls.

<a id="BounceTweenEquation-constant-IN_OUT"></a>

### IN_OUT

`BounceTweenEquation IN_OUT` 

Bounces at the start and at the end.
